MinchoCandyWars.StellarisEvent.Stellaris.label: Final operation
MinchoCandyWars.StellarisEvent.Stellaris.title: Qinxintang
MinchoCandyWars.StellarisEvent.Stellaris.desc:
Thank you, my dear ally, as always.
We are finally ready to strike the reclamation force site. They may come back, but we believe this time we can hurt them badly.
Here is the plan: we will harass and raid them without pause to buy you time; you must become an ice pick and drive straight into the heart of their headquarters to destroy their contact computer. Cut off from headquarters, they will lose their footing on this world!

li.label: Yes - it is time to settle accounts with them
li.desc: Accept the final operation and head to the reclamation force headquarters to destroy the contact computer.

li.label: Later - wait! We are not ready yet!
li.desc: Decide later and close the window. You can contact the Mincho Alliance again when ready.

MinchoCandyWars.StellarisEvent.Stellaris.label: Thanks
MinchoCandyWars.StellarisEvent.Stellaris.title: Qinxintang
MinchoCandyWars.StellarisEvent.Stellaris.desc:
Thank you! My ally! We have finally beaten them, and I think my mission is complete. We paid a great price, but it was worth it!
We are free of them at last and can hand out ice cream across this world as much as we like! I think I should visit you first. May I?

li.label: Yes - welcome! I have wanted you to visit for a long time!
li.desc: Qinxintang will come to your colony.

li.label: Later - wait! Let me tidy the room first!
li.desc: Decide later and close the window. You can contact the Mincho Alliance again afterwards.
